scope: End-to-end purchase flow for TTACart: login, add to cart, cart review, checkout, order total verification, and order confirmation.
risks: Flaky UI elements (cart badge, checkout buttons)
Potential price rounding differences causing total verification failures
Network latency may affect page load timings
coverage_gap: Existing library lacks tests for cart review (product quantity), checkout information entry, order total calculation verification, and final order confirmation page.

test_cases.title: Login with valid standard_user credentials
test_cases.expected_result: User lands on the products page and the Products heading is visible.

test_cases.title: Login fails with invalid credentials
steps: Verify error message reads "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"
test_cases.expected_result: Error alert is displayed and the user stays on the login page.

test_cases.title: Add first product to cart updates cart badge
steps: Click "Add to cart" on the first product (Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)) on the inventory page
Read the cart badge in the header
test_cases.expected_result: The cart badge shows the number 1.

test_cases.title: Cart review shows added product with quantity 1
steps: Add the first product to the cart
Click the cart icon to navigate to https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/cart
Verify the product appears in the cart list with quantity set to 1
test_cases.expected_result: The cart page lists the selected product and shows a quantity of 1.

test_cases.title: Checkout information entry leads to overview page
steps: Add a product to the cart and open the cart page
On https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/checkout-step-one, enter First Name "John", Last Name "Doe", Zip/Postal Code "12345"
test_cases.expected_result: User lands on the Checkout Overview page.

test_cases.title: Verify order total equals item total plus tax
steps: Perform the checkout flow up to the Checkout Overview page (as in TC05)
Read the displayed Item total value
Calculate Item total + Tax and compare with Total
test_cases.expected_result: Item total plus Tax equals the displayed Total.

test_cases.title: Complete order and see confirmation heading
steps: Perform the checkout flow up to the Checkout Overview page (as in TC05)
Verify the page heading reads "Thank you for your order!"
test_cases.expected_result: The order confirmation page is displayed with the expected heading.
